content.text: Kawmpoi e tadamtui hoi canganae kho patetlah,
tamipathu hoi barinae kamcu hoeh.
Kamleng rumram e pusu hoi pingpit patetlah,
a khuekhaw awm laipalah thoebo e teh api koehai bawt mahoeh.
Marang hanelah ruibongpai,
la hanelah kammoumrui,
tamipathu e keng hanelah bongpai teh a kamcu doeh.
Tamipathu teh a pathunae patetlah pato hanh,
hoehpawiteh ama patetlah na awm payon vaih.
Tamipathu teh a pathunae patetlah pato,
hoehpawiteh a lungkaang lah kâpouk payon vaih.
Tamipathu koe lawk ka thui e tami teh
amae khok ka tâtueng ni teh rawknae tui ka net e lah ao.
Khokkhem e khoktakan a kânging hoeh e patetlah,
tamipathu e pahni dawk cingthuilawk teh ao.
Tamipathu bari e teh tâyaicung dawk
hluemhluem kawm e patetlah doeh ao.
Tamipathunaw ni dei e cingthuilawk teh
yamuhri kut dawk ka um e pâkhing hoi a kâvan.
Bangpuengpa kasakkung lentoe Cathut ni
tamipathu hoi kâtapoe kung aphu a poe.
Ui ni a palo bout a ca e patetlah tamipathu ni
a pathunae hah a kamnue sak.
Ama pouknae dawk tamilungkaang lah ka kâpouk e na hmu ou.
Hote tami koehoi hlak teh tamipathu koehoi
ngaihawinae bet aohnawn.
Tami pangak ni, lam dawk sendek ao,
thongma vah sendek ao telah a ti.
Tho teh takhang dawk a kâhei e patetlah
tami pangak teh ikhun dawk a kâhei.
Tami pangak ni rawca a kâyap teh
a kâtu hane boehai ngai hoeh.
Ka pangak e ni, kahawicalah khopouk thai e tami sari touh hlak
ka lunganghnawn telah a kâpouk.
Yuengyoe cei lahoi ayânaw e kong dawk ka bawk e tami teh
ui hnâ ka kuen e hoi a kâvan.
Na pacai e doeh na a tihoi,
a imri ka dum e tami teh,
hmaito, pala, duenae hoi
ka ka e tamipathu hoi a kâvan.
Thing awm hoehpawiteh hmai a roum e patetlah,
tamcueklawk deinae awm hoehpawiteh kâyuenae hai a roum.
Hmaisaan ni hmaisaei a kamtawi sak,
thing ni hmai a kak sak e patetlah,
kâoun ka ngai e ni kâyuenae a kamtawi sak.
Tamcueklawk teh katuipounge rawca patetlah ao teh,
von thung a kâen.
Apâhni pâhnan hoi lungthinkathout e tami teh,
talai hlaam ngun hoi pâbing e hoi a kâvan.
Tami hmuhmanae ka tawn e tami ni a pahni hoi a hro teh,
a lung thung dumyennae hah a hro.
Pahren lahoi, ati ei nakunghai yuem hanh,
bangkongtetpawiteh a lungthung vah panuettho e sari touh ao.
A hmuhmanae hah dumnae lahoi ka hrawk nakunghai,
thoenae teh tamimaya ni panuenae koe
kamnue sak lah ao han.
Tangkom kataikung teh a tai e tangkom dawk a bo han,
talung kapaletkung koe talung bout a kamlei han.
Laithoe ka dei e ni a rektap e naw hah ouk a hmuhma,
oupnae kaphawk ni rawknae a tâcokhai.
